findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 5 in the same format as Chapter 1 (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 81 questions numbered 1-81; by section: 5.1 7, 5.2 2, 5.3 13, 5.4 3, 5.5 5, 5.6 6, 5.7 8, 5.8 5, 5.9 4, 5.10 1, 5.11 3, 5.12 9, 5.13 5, 5.14 4, 5.15 2, 5.16 4.

Covers sections 5.1-5.16 in order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals use values changed from the book's examples and were recomputed in Python (g = 9.8 m s⁻²); none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: fused silica (not silicon), shear strain γ = Δx/y = tan θ, Thomas Young.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
